title: Create src/lib/log.ts — progress log writer
description: Create a module that appends session summaries to .agent/logs/LOG.md after each loop session. Records timestamp, task info, backend, iteration count, outcome, and elapsed time.
acceptanceCriteria: Creates LOG.md if it doesn't exist
Appends a markdown section with timestamp, task title, backend name, iteration count, outcome, and elapsed time
Existing LOG.md content is preserved (append, not overwrite)

steps.details: Create the file. Import fs-extra and path. Define: export type SessionLog = { taskId: number; taskTitle: string; backend: string; iterations: number; outcome: 'complete' | 'blocked' | 'max-iterations' | 'error'; elapsedMs: number; timestamp: Date }

export async function appendSessionLog(agentDir: string, log: SessionLog): Promise<void> { const logPath = path.join(agentDir, 'logs', 'LOG.md'); await fs.ensureDir(path.dirname(logPath)); const section = formatLogSection(log); await fs.appendFile(logPath, section + '\n', 'utf-8') }

technicalNotes: Use fs.appendFile (not writeFile) to ensure existing log entries are preserved
LOG.md format must be parseable by logReader.ts (TASK-133) — keep the format consistent
